best_idea: Send a reliable event with one random id and deliver only the first copy the receiver sees (id kept for a window); skip unreliable inputs while the outbound queue is non-empty and count the drop.
decision_why: The first-copy-only id receive fits the one-ledger ruling (a kill credited once), but the 10-copy resend storm only helps on a lossy link and the Frankendom transport was not read; ledger dedupe must be stored with the ledger entry, not in a 15 s window.
acceptance: Server test: the same kill-report id arriving three times over the link credits the ledger once, even after a reconnect; and an unreliable input frame is counted as a drop while the outbound queue is non-empty, while a kill report still sends.
